parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID.

You must specify the instance ID. Otherwise, the call fails. You can view your instance ID on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.
><notice>
If the public instance does not have an ID, see [How to obtain an instance ID](~~267533~~).
></notice>

parameters.name: SoundCodeList
parameters.description: The list of unique identifiers of sound codes. A maximum of 100 elements can be specified.
